answer: Verifiable-random-function (VRF) admission resists sybils concretely. Each candidate signs the public epoch seed with its secret key to mint one unique, publicly verifiable ticket; only sparse tickets qualify, and a key can never yield two. A forger must hold a separate secret key per fake identity and cannot recycle any, because reused keys collide and trigger automatic slashing of bonded stake. Imagine a secluded island where one operator parks cloned agents under a basalt ridge beside a deep canyon—their shared keys still expose the farm and forfeit every deposit.
